decision_rule: On screen and confirmation, reject any lost control finish, paired increase in collisions or damage, paired DNF progress decrease, or shared completed lap more than 5 percent slower. Retain only if no such regression and candidate gains at least one finish, or at equal finishes reduces total time on mutually completed laps. Missing cells, operational errors, failed spot-check reproducibility, or source/model/protocol hash mismatch block sealing. Screen-selected candidate and hashes freeze before confirmation; confirmation is pass/fail only. Blind is opened only after passing confirmation and is reported without candidate reselection or tuning.
limits: One official-generator episode per arm and cell, with cold-process repeats only at listed spot checks. Track IDs sharing a geometry seed are correlated and repeats do not add independent sample size. A positive result on 16 screen and 32 confirmation cells is descriptive evidence, not a guarantee on every possible track or official container certification.
